---
title: "YellowtailComparison"
format: pdf
editor: visual
---


```{r echo=FALSE}
mom6alt<-read.csv("yellowtail_MOM6.csv")%>%
  mutate(model="MOM6v2")
mom6<-read.csv("Output/YellowtailMOM6_COMPARISON.csv")
glorys<-read.csv("yellowtail_GLORYs.csv")%>%
  mutate(model="GLORYS")

mom6alt_long<-mom6alt%>%pivot_longer(
    cols =-c(year, model),       
    names_to = "variable", 
    values_to = "values"  
  )

glorys_long<-glorys%>%pivot_longer(
    cols =-c(year, model),       
    names_to = "variable", 
    values_to = "values"  
  )


mom6_long<-mom6%>%pivot_longer(
    cols =-c(year, model),       
    names_to = "variable", 
    values_to = "values"  
  )%>%filter(year>=1994&year<=2023)

mom6_alt<-mom6_long%>%
  bind_rows(mom6alt_long)%>%
  bind_rows(glorys_long)%>%
  filter(variable %in% intersect(unique(mom6_long$variable), unique(mom6alt_long$variable)))

mom6_alt_corr<-mom6_long%>%select(-model)%>%
  rename(mom6_values=values)%>%
  inner_join(mom6alt_long)%>%#select(-model)%>%
  group_by(variable,model)%>%
   mutate(standardized_mom6= scale(mom6_values),standardized_roms= scale(values))%>%
   summarise(
     correlation = cor(standardized_mom6, standardized_roms),
     .groups = "drop"
   )%>%
   mutate(corr=round(correlation, 3))


unstandardized<-ggplot(data=mom6_alt, aes(x=year, y=values,col=model))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y")+
  ggtitle("Unstandardized")+
  theme_classic()


mom6_roms_stand<-mom6_alt%>%
  group_by(model, variable)%>%
  group_by(model)%>%
  mutate(standardized_values= scale(values))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  left_join(data.frame(mom6_alt_corr))
  
  standardized<-ggplot(data=mom6_roms_stand, aes(x=year, y=standardized_values,col=model, label=corr))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~variable)+
  ggtitle("Standardized")+
  geom_text(aes(x = 2010, y = 2, label =corr) )+
  theme_classic()
   standardized
```
